## B — Audience, Chapter Five, the graduated driver license program

The audience is first-time, never-licensed Vermont applicants, typically teenagers on the learner's permit and junior license path and adults applying for a first driver's license, reading at a plain-English level with no assumed driving vocabulary. This section teaches the graduated license law as it binds every learner's permit and junior driver's license holder: supervision, the practice hour and clean record clocks, the three passenger stages, employment and for-hire limits, the step up to a full license, out-of-state junior licenses, and the recall rules with their terms. The content assumes no prior rule knowledge and no prerequisites beyond literacy; every term the section introduces is defined in the glossary lines of part C.

corpus_stability.reason: The Vermont Driver's Manual is a single pinned edition (Vermont Driver’s Manual 2025; VN-007 07/2024 MTC) revised no more than once a year by the issuer; no faster-changing corpus feeds this section.
